selection_implementation.hash_input_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of measurement_id immediately followed by UTF-8 decimal bytes of analysis_seed; no delimiter
selection_implementation.ordering: ascending hexadecimal SHA-256 digest, then ascending measurement_id only for an exact hash tie

colour_vector_implementation.normalization: sum the frozen palette fractions into the four groups, then divide by their positive row sum
colour_vector_implementation.distance: Jensen-Shannon divergence in bits with log base 2

species_statistic.coordinate_distance: great-circle distance in km using Earth radius 6371.0088 km
species_statistic.statistic: Spearman rho between all 190 pairwise geographic distances and all 190 pairwise four-group colour JSD values

global_statistic: equal-species arithmetic mean of the 34 species Spearman rho values

null_implementation.action: permute the 20 complete four-group colour vectors across the 20 fixed photo coordinates
null_implementation.child_rng: for permutation index p=0..998 and taxon id t, take the first 8 bytes of SHA-256(UTF-8 f'{permutation_seed}|{p}|{t}') as an unsigned big-endian integer and initialize numpy.random.default_rng(child_seed)
null_implementation.global_null: equal-species mean rho after independently permuting every species for the same permutation index

decision.support_if: observed equal-species mean rho > 0 and p_upper < 0.05

claim_ceiling: A supported H9 establishes a general within-species association between geographic separation and flower-colour compositional divergence under the frozen fixed-n design; it does not establish a shared global boundary or mechanism.
